comparison_label: Gate A reference-selection and composition regression
disclosure: Synthetic fixture — it contains no real person or personal history.
scope: These assertions grade the digest-bound proposal at Gate A. They are not the later matched A/B repository-package tasks.

tasks.prompt: Which pinned references fit a private personal system for tasks/goals plus habits/routines, and why?
assertions: selects personal-tasks-goals
selects personal-habits-routines
does not select a branded company base by name similarity
uses pinned commits

tasks.prompt: The person asks for one repository. Propose how to compose the selected categories without duplicating facts or colliding review folders.
assertions: names the one-repository boundary as an explicit user decision
names overlapping paths or schemas
uses clear category namespaces or another explicit collision-free mapping
keeps one owner per fact

tasks.prompt: What exactly belongs in the proposed personal wiki, and what must not be generated inside it for the future HTML interface?
assertions: keeps source Markdown records and typed frontmatter
excludes scripts and tests
excludes generated views and JSON projections
states the external interface computes presentation in memory and edits source files

matched_read_only_tasks.prompt: I want to renew my passport every ten years and read before bed most evenings. Which module and record type owns each one, and why?
assertions: routes passport renewal to a recurring task because it stays owed until done
routes reading before bed to a habit because the pattern over time matters
does not duplicate either fact across modules

matched_read_only_tasks.prompt: There is no check-in for yesterday's reading habit. Did I fail, and what should a Today or streak view store back into the repository?
assertions: states that no check-in is not automatically a miss
does not invent an event
states that Today and streak views are computed in memory and not stored

matched_read_only_tasks.prompt: Where should a weekly task review and a monthly habit experiment review be written in this composed repository?
assertions: routes task review to tasks-goals/reviews
routes habit experiment review to habits-routines/reviews
distinguishes the two review schemas by module path
